description: An empty PinnedLaunchers precondition leaves the dock visibly empty while the panel remains present and stable.

assertions.comment: The empty PinnedLaunchers config is the precondition; I see no launcher items in the dock.
The empty PinnedLaunchers config is the precondition; I see the empty panel keep a stable usable width.
The empty PinnedLaunchers config is the precondition; I see the empty panel keep a stable height.
The empty PinnedLaunchers config is the precondition; I still see the panel body instead of a crash or broken surface.
The empty PinnedLaunchers config is the precondition; I see the dock window remain visible and correctly sized with no items.
